description: The desktop AI apps that make up the bulk of the demo table.
why: The four bundle ids that used to be must_contain are now must_find on the classifier, which is the layer that actually knows them. ChatGPT's id is a LIST because run 33511815638 showed the same cask resolving to two builds -- 26.721.41059 with com.openai.codex on macos-15, 1.2026.160 with com.openai.chat on macos-14 -- and both are real. It stays a raw probe rather than being dropped for the classifier: `chatgpt` matches on the brew route too, so must_find would still pass with every bundle id in the catalog broken, and this is the only assertion that reads the row. perplexity-desktop moved to 11-perplexity-desktop for its macOS >= 15 floor and is FORBIDDEN here rather than dropped: an assertion that merely stopped naming it could not tell 'no longer installed' from 'route quietly broken'.
known_gaps: Paid or account-gated in several cases. The install is unattended and the sign-in is not, so nothing exercises behaviour that only appears once a user is signed in.
